mars_environment: Thin atmosphere, less than 1% as dense as Earth's
Frequent dust and occasional planet-wide dust storms
Very cold, especially at night and in winter
No liquid water on the surface
Commands from Earth take minutes to arrive

problems.title: Dust on solar panels (Opportunity, InSight)
problems.problem: Dust stops sunlight from reaching the solar panels, so the spacecraft runs out of power.
problems.problem_ar: الغبار يمنع ضوء الشمس من الوصول إلى الألواح الشمسية، فتنفد طاقة المركبة.
problems.root_cause: Martian dust settles on the panels or blocks the Sun during dust storms. A planet-wide storm in June 2018 cut Opportunity's power, and dust buildup reduced InSight's power until its mission ended.
nasa_tried: Sent more than 1,000 recovery commands to Opportunity after the storm
Tried to shake InSight's panels with their deployment motors (did not work)
Trickled sand near InSight's panels in the wind with the robotic arm scoop (small power gain only)
Large rovers such as Curiosity use nuclear power instead of solar (a known option, but heavier and more costly)
constraints: Solar is the lightest and simplest power option
Every extra kilogram is costly to launch
No humans to clean the panels
problems.fact: Opportunity was built to work for 90 Martian days, but it kept going for more than 14 years and drove 45 km.
problems.fact_ar: صُممت أبورتشونيتي لتعمل 90 يوماً مريخياً، لكنها استمرت أكثر من 14 عاماً وقطعت 45 كيلومتراً.

problems.title: Heat probe could not dig (InSight mole)
problems.title_ar: مسبار الحرارة لم يستطع الحفر (خُلد إنسايت)
problems.problem: A self-hammering heat probe could not dig into the Martian soil.
problems.problem_ar: مسبار حرارة يدقّ نفسه في الأرض لم يستطع الحفر في تربة المريخ.
problems.root_cause: The soil clumped together and did not give the probe the friction it needed to pull itself down.
nasa_tried: Pressed on the probe with the robotic arm scoop
Scraped soil on top of the probe to add friction
Almost two years of attempts, which ended in January 2021
problems.fact: InSight's heat probe was designed to dig 5 meters deep. After almost two years of trying, it only got just below the surface.
problems.fact_ar: صُمم مسبار الحرارة في إنسايت ليحفر 5 أمتار في عمق المريخ، لكنه بعد قرابة عامين من المحاولة لم يتجاوز ما تحت السطح بقليل.

problems.title: Stuck in hidden soft sand (Spirit)
problems.problem: The rover got stuck in hidden soft sand and could not drive out.
problems.problem_ar: المركبة علقت في رمل ناعم مخفي ولم تستطع الخروج منه.
problems.root_cause: In May 2009 its wheels broke through a thin surface crust into soft sand underneath. It was driving on only five working wheels.
nasa_tried: Months of tests with a rover model on Earth and planned escape drives
Turned Spirit into a stationary science station
constraints: The soft sand is hidden under a crust
Drives are planned from Earth with long delays
problems.fact: Spirit was built for 90 Martian days but worked for more than 6 years, until it got stuck in soft sand in 2009.
problems.fact_ar: صُممت سبيريت لتعمل 90 يوماً مريخياً، لكنها عملت أكثر من 6 سنوات، حتى علقت في رمل ناعم عام 2009.

problems.title: Lost over smooth sand (Ingenuity)
problems.problem: The helicopter lost track of its position and speed over smooth sand, landed hard and damaged its rotor blades.
problems.problem_ar: المروحية فقدت معرفة موقعها وسرعتها فوق رمال ملساء، فهبطت بقوة وتضررت شفراتها.
problems.root_cause: Its navigation camera tracks surface features. Over featureless sand ripples it had too few features to track (flight 72, January 2024).
nasa_tried: The investigation recommended better navigation over low-texture terrain for future Mars helicopters
constraints: Lift is hard in the thin atmosphere
problems.fact: In April 2021, Ingenuity made the first powered, controlled flight on another planet. It was planned for 5 flights and made 72.
problems.fact_ar: في أبريل 2021 حققت إنجينيويتي أول طيران متحكَّم به بمحرك على كوكب آخر. خُطط لها 5 رحلات، فطارت 72 رحلة.
